answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 20828 Country: India Title: i saw a scorpion in dream Question: i saw a scorpion in dream Answer ID: 20828 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 672/528/H=1431) Scorpion means nafs i.e. one should fear following the carnal desires; because some time one can run high loss due to the sting of carnal trick, slyness and dubiety. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
